verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a hosted and self-hostable data-sync and search platform like Airweave, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or any setting to disable them. The documented local self-hosting option (docs-14, docs-31) does not by itself show that telemetry can be turned off, so it is not credited.
